name: MU_ParkingPermit_GetPaymentToken
description: Serverless API. Receives a registrationId and permitType, looks up the fee server-side, calls Authorize.net getHostedPaymentPageRequest, and returns the one-time hosted payment form token plus the form URL. The caller (Experience card) POSTs the token to the form URL to open the Authorize.net hosted payment page in a new tab (redirect mode — Authorize.net shows the receipt).

formUrl.title: URL to POST the token to
